agency_session_name.description: Specifies the name of the agency session. The name contains 2 to 64 characters and can only contain letters, digits, underscores (_) and hyphens (-).

agency_urn.description: Specifies the uniform resource name of the trust agency to be assumed, in the format of iam::{account_id}:agency:{agency_name}.

assumed_agency.description: The information about the assumed agency session.

audience.description: The client ID returned from the aud or azp field of the ID token.

duration_seconds.description: Specifies the validity period of the temporary security credentials, in seconds. The value ranges from 900 to 43200 and defaults to 3600.

id_token.description: Specifies the OpenID Connect ID token issued by the OIDC identity provider.

idp_urn.description: The uniform resource name of the OIDC identity provider.

policy.description: Specifies a custom policy in JSON format, which is used to further restrict the permissions of the temporary security credentials.

policy_ids.description: Specifies the list of preset policy IDs, which is used to restrict the permissions of the temporary security credentials. A maximum of 20 policy IDs can be configured.

provider_urn.description: Specifies the uniform resource name of the OIDC identity provider, in the format of iam::{account_id}:oidcProvider:{provider_name}.

source_identity.description: The source identity declared by the source identity field of the ID token.

subject_from_id_token.description: The unique user identifier returned from the sub field of the ID token.
